mindfront_female_trousers_1.author: Mindfront
mindfront_female_trousers_1.description: Tags: Female Trousers Jeans Pants. Jeans with embroidery for female makehuman character. There is already great female jeans made by punkduck but as I made this for a future scene I thought they may be useful for somebody else. This time I did the whole belt area as tre vertex hard body to minimize deformation of the belt and buckle thereof fitness adjustments around that area may be necessary when posing. Some texture and mesh distortion may occur between the legs in some poses. In Blender use the 'solidify' modifier with 'Thickness' about 3mm and 'Fill Rim' and 'Only Rim' to give the fabric some thickness. Preview image rendered in Blender Cycles with 'tennis shoes' by punkduck and the top 'floral' by o4saken.

mindfront_male_trousers_1.author: Mindfront
mindfront_male_trousers_1.description: Tags: Male Trousers Jeans Pants. Loose fit slightly dirty jeans for male makehuman character. Some texture and mesh distortion may occur between the legs in some poses. They are ment to be used with at least one level subsurf. In Blender use the 'solidify' modifier with 'Thickness' about 3mm and 'Fill Rim' and 'Only Rim' to give the fabric some thickness. Preview image rendered in Blender Cycles and with subsurf level 2.

mindfront_male_trousers_2.author: Mindfront
mindfront_male_trousers_2.description: Tags: Male Trousers Pants. Soft thick suit trousers with simple texture. These trousers was original not made for MakeHuman and unnecessary high poly. In Blender use the 'solidify' modifier with 'Thickness' about 3mm and 'Fill Rim' and 'Only Rim' to give the fabric some thickness.

punkduck_female_tight_jeans.author: punkduck
punkduck_female_tight_jeans.description: A pair of tight jeans with a lot of details like pockets seams etc. Delete groups are used. The textures can also be used for the short jeans. Edit: A normal-map is added. Best way to use the material in Blender: duplicate it and use a less glossy version for the fabric e.g. connect input color of glossy shader to output of diffuse texture you can also delete the fresnel and use a fixed value instead use the glossy version for the buttons set roughness of glossy shader to a low value . Change: I added the 'delete_verts' to the end of the .mhclo file. If you do not want them simply throw these lines away.

punkduck_male_classic_jeans.author: punkduck
punkduck_male_classic_jeans.description: A classic black jeans for males the texture should look like this jeans is new and not yet washed. A second blue texture will be added to the materials. Also a belt is added to the clothes folder to fit to this jeans. A normalmap is added. Feel free to assign rivets and button to a glossy shader in Blender.
